name: jam chutney
instructions:
The shortcut chutney — jam, chili, vinegar. A fruity dipping sauce built to NOT depend on the usual aromatic stack.

=== INGREDIENTS ===

- APRICOT JAM
- MANGO JAM
- KASHMIRI CHILI POWDER
- APPLE CIDER VINEGAR
- [[salsa-bruja]] — makes it funkier, and a good way to use the bruja
- GINGER (fresh or powder) — primary
- (optional) GARLIC — more indian tasting, but I tire of the flavor (secondary; see notes)

=== PROCEDURE ===

Stir together; taste — vinegar against the jams' sweetness, kashmiri for color and warmth, bruja for funk.
notes:
=== THE POINT — A FRUITY DIP NOT DEPENDENT ON THE AROMATIC STACK ===

Cumin, coriander, onion powder, and garlic powder are left out ON PURPOSE (clashing): it would be nice to have a fun dipping sauce that ISN'T dependent on those flavors. Every other chutney/dip in this register leans on them — this one is fruit + heat + acid + funk.

GINGER IS PRIMARY (fresh or powder) — it belongs in the structure. Notably, this is a GOOD PLACE FOR GINGER POWDER, whereas it's usually not as useful in indian food. GARLIC stays SECONDARY, ambivalent: it makes it more INDIAN TASTING, but I get tired of the flavor — optional, not structural.

=== SALSA BRUJA — THE FUNK ===

[[salsa-bruja]] in the mix makes it FUNKIER, and it's a good way to USE the bruja (the quart lasts months; this is one of its jobs).
